name: Range
summary: Slider for selecting a value from a range.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 22/08/2026, not read off the APG: Range is a native <input type=range> and the browser already ships all eight keys. The ficha declared four, so the docs under-sold an accessibility contract the component honours.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: Native bounds. The thumb is themed by tokens; the behaviour is the browser's.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Pair it with a text field when the exact number matters.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A vertical slider. The engine publishes the orientation and the arrow keys follow it, so this is not only a rotation.
